phase: P9 F1 measurement framework — Phase 0 extension attempt
intent: Add ROUGE-L F1 + BLEU-2 + BLEU-3 to existing holdout-500 BLEU-1 per-prompt artifacts; recompute Llama-3.2-3B anchor on same metrics; build composite F1_v3 = mean(BLEU-1, ROUGE-L, BLEU-2) normalized to anchor.
verdict_short: Per-prompt JSONs persist only the BLEU-1 scalar score; the underlying model-generated tokens (gen_tok) and reference tokens (ref_tok) were discarded by the eval script after BLEU-1 was computed. ROUGE-L and BLEU-2/3 cannot be computed from BLEU-1 scalars (information-lossy). Recomputation requires re-running all 5 LoRA models against the 500-prompt holdout on GPU substrate (ubu1 / RunPod), which is out of scope for this Mac-only / READ-ONLY task.

cheap_alternative_lower_bound_via_quanti.claim: Even WITHOUT computing ROUGE-L, we can place a probabilistic lower bound on whether ablation_B's BLEU-1 lead survives ROUGE-L extension.
reasoning: ablation_B's BLEU-1 mean (0.01196) is 88% higher than the next-best ckpt (ablation_A at 0.00651)
ablation_B has frac_pos = 0.267 vs 0.140-0.166 for the others — i.e. it produces non-trivial unigram overlap on 60-90% more prompts
ROUGE-L F1 on token sequences correlates with BLEU-1 unigram precision because both reward token-level overlap; correlation is typically r > 0.6 on short greedy outputs (per ROUGE/BLEU literature)
Therefore: P(ablation_B retains rank-1 under ROUGE-L | BLEU-1 lead = 88%, frac_pos lead = 60%) is plausibly > 0.7 but UNVERIFIED

Mid-pack reordering (phase1_5 vs phase1_6 vs ablation_A vs y1) is highly likely under ROUGE-L because all 4 are within ±1 SE on BLEU-1 — ROUGE-L recall axis introduces independent noise that could permute these 4 freely

honest_c3_caveats: (C3-1) DATA_BLOCKER not METHOD_FAILURE: Phase 0 extension was correctly scoped but assumed gen_tok would be persisted in per-prompt JSONs. They are not. The blocker is upstream eval-script design, not the Phase 0 spec itself — DO NOT count this as Phase 0 'failing' or BLEU-1 framework being insufficient; we have NOT yet measured anything new.

(C3-2) ANCHOR_STALENESS_BLEU1: Even the existing BLEU-1 Llama anchor (0.1555) was measured on N=32 NOT N=500, so the 0.85 ratio gate (0.132) compared to holdout-500 ckpt means is technically sample-mismatched. Llama anchor recomputation on holdout-500 is required for BLEU-1 too, not just for ROUGE-L/BLEU-2/3.

(C3-3) RANKING_NARRATIVE_NOT_PROOF: The 'ablation_B dominance' verdict is currently single-metric (BLEU-1). The Phase 0 motivation IS the worry that BLEU-1 alone may be misleading; running the F1 framework upgrade halfway (ranking by BLEU-1 only while citing the upgrade doc) would be epistemic theater. Either run the full Phase 0 measurement on GPU substrate or explicitly stamp the ranking 'BLEU-1 ONLY, ROUGE-L NOT MEASURED'.
